R1 a source id that cannot be drawn answers record-core's mintExhausted for SRC (its R62, C-59.6), and nothing is written, not even a knock bound in the same read

R1 refusals: NO_SUCH_SOURCE for a capture that is not a pulled knock, a knock not pulled or discarded, a malformed digest, and a viewer naming no active member; each carries its row and writes nothing

R1, R8 the sourceOfReads fixture: a capture with no source and a fetched capture answer NO_SUCH_SOURCE, a capture with a source answers its stated source and history, and publishableAt shows nothing unconsented
R10 a link that moves the linked source's rung (a same_secret basis) calls each listener for that source too, with the same entry; an evidence link, which moves it not, only for the source

R10 each registration goes through membership.listenerRefusal; each listener is called after every R2, R6, R7 (and R11) commit with {source, entry, rung_before, rung_after}; a listener's failure never undoes the act
R11 a source proves who they are by presenting their knocker secret and consents to, or withdraws from, one entry for one audience, as R7 records a consent

R11 SECRET_NOT_RECOGNISED is answered identically for every failure: a wrong secret, a short one, none, another source's entry, an unknown entry, a bad audience, a lower audience than stands, a malformed call
R11 the act is rate-bound as a knock is, in the same windows as knocks: a consent attempt counts as a knock from its source (doorbell R2, R17; K530)

R11 the rate is counted on one clock: an attempt the control plane sends no instant for is counted at this module's clock, never the wall clock, and the knock window holds across its edge (doorbell R2, R17)
R11, R22 the knockerconsent fixture: a pending entry is shown to no one, the knocker's own consent by secret answers ok for it, and once it stands the entry is shown with basis consent
R12 the capturing member is never recorded as the source of what someone else gave them: a source is a knocker's, never the pulling member's, and a capture a member fetched has none
R13 a value is never written to a log, an error or a listener payload
R13 every table here is exempt from purge: a whole-store and a one-bundle purge leave every row, and no other module may declare one
R14 C-121.1–C-121.10 are held in this module's own table with their requirement's codes and translations (R16's four with them), and no place is named in its behaviour or outward text
R14 the ops: sourcedisclose, sourcelink, sourceconsent, sourceconsentwithdraw, knockerconsent and sourcekeyed reach their services with the control plane's stamps, never a body's

R15 source_knocks is a read contract: exactly the columns (knock_id, source_id, capture_sha, bytes, received), one row per pulled knock a minted source stands behind, written when the source is minted, holding no value, secret or contact

R16 markKeyedResult records that a capture is a member-keyed result, by that member's own act on their own capture, with the vendor and the terms as stated; appended with by and the instant, never edited or removed
R16 refusals, in order, each with its row and a negative control, writing nothing: MACHINE_CANNOT_MARK, NO_SERVICE, NO_SUCH_CAPTURE, NOT_YOUR_CAPTURE
R16 the op sourcekeyed reaches markKeyedResult with the control plane's stamp, never a body's

R17 keyedResultOf answers a marked capture's {member_keyed: true, service, by, at, reproducible_by_public: false, grade_cap}, else null, and never throws; grade_cap is one rank below the capture's own letter in BASIS_GRADES' order, D staying D

R18 no path takes rows in bulk from a member-keyed source, no act runs unattended, and nothing records what a member searched for: one capture per act, by an active member's own stamp, holding the vendor and terms only
R19 every table is declared explicitly through record-core's declareTable with its classes, exempt from purge (R13); the disclosures, stored values, read log and keyed marks are never exported
R2 a disclosure is appended with its stamped by and instant, never edited; every kind, how and knownTo is admitted and a later entry supersedes an earlier one on read
R2 refusals in order, each with its row and a negative control: NO_SUCH_SOURCE, BAD_DISCLOSURE naming the field, NO_EVIDENCE; nothing is written

R20 bounds: only changes strictly after `since` and at or before the read's own instant (this module's clock); `since` read as an instant in any ISO 8601 spelling
R20 is reached by no route and answered to no viewer: no op of this module calls it
R20 N90's bound: at most `limit` changes (default 200, clamped 1…1000), with `truncated` and `next`, the cursor passed back as `after`
R20 recorded order at one instant: a disclosure before a consent, each table in the order it was written
R20 refusals: NO_SUCH_SOURCE (C-121.1) as R8 answers it; a `since` that is not an ISO 8601 instant answers changes: null with since_invalid, never an empty list; it never throws

R21 sources declares sourceconsentwithdraw: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R21 sources declares sourcedisclose: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R21 sources declares sourcelink: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R22 sources declares knockerconsent: no field is required, so no call names one, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused naming it
R22 sources: through the door a knockerconsent with its accepted fields records the consent, and each omitted field answers the one refusal, naming no field

R3 a hostile disclosure is stored as the exposer's claim and read as "named by <claimed_by> on <date>; not confirmed by the group", confirmed false always; a confirmation is its own entry, publishable only by the source's consent
R4 recorded: false records a detail known to the group without its value: the entry holds none and no read answers one

R5 a stored value needs a non-empty sight list (NO_SIGHT_LIST); only listed members read it, every other viewer reads it withheld; each read answering a value is logged, and the log is answered to listed members and administrators
R6 linkClaim records a pseudonym_link disclosure with its evidence and merges nothing; a presented knocker secret of either source makes its basis same_secret; NO_SUCH_SOURCE for either side

R7 a consent covers one entry for one audience, stated as permanent; a withdrawal binds only later publications; CONSENT_NOT_STANDING for an entry not in the history or an audience lower than what already stands
R8 (T47) op=sourcepublishable evaluates at this module's own instant: a query `now` or `at` (or a body's) is ignored; the in-process publishableAt keeps its stated `at`

R8 publishableAt answers each entry that may be shown to the audience, with its value and its basis (consent not withdrawn at `at`, or public_elsewhere: knownTo public with a citation, never a hostile one alone); every other entry is left out; it writes nothing and never throws
R9 rungOf answers the ladder: unknown; same_knocker (proved by the secret); partly_known; known_to_group; publicly_known; each with who knows and how, a withheld value staying withheld

tests: R15 source_knocks is a read contract: exactly the columns (knock_id, source_id, capture_sha, bytes, received), one row per pulled knock a minted source stands behind, written when the source is minted, holding no value, secret or contact
R1 a source id that cannot be drawn answers record-core's mintExhausted for SRC (its R62, C-59.6), and nothing is written, not even a knock bound in the same read
R10 a link that moves the linked source's rung (a same_secret basis) calls each listener for that source too, with the same entry; an evidence link, which moves it not, only for the source

R16 markKeyedResult records that a capture is a member-keyed result, by that member's own act on their own capture, with the vendor and the terms as stated; appended with by and the instant, never edited or removed
R16 refusals, in order, each with its row and a negative control, writing nothing: MACHINE_CANNOT_MARK, NO_SERVICE, NO_SUCH_CAPTURE, NOT_YOUR_CAPTURE
R16 the op sourcekeyed reaches markKeyedResult with the control plane's stamp, never a body's

R17 keyedResultOf answers a marked capture's {member_keyed: true, service, by, at, reproducible_by_public: false, grade_cap}, else null, and never throws; grade_cap is one rank below the capture's own letter in BASIS_GRADES' order, D staying D

R18 no path takes rows in bulk from a member-keyed source, no act runs unattended, and nothing records what a member searched for: one capture per act, by an active member's own stamp, holding the vendor and terms only
R1 a source exists for each pulled knock: one per pseudonym, one per knock sent without a secret; sourceOf answers the capture's own source verbatim and the source's current history beside it

R1 refusals: NO_SUCH_SOURCE for a capture that is not a pulled knock, a knock not pulled or discarded, a malformed digest, and a viewer naming no active member; each carries its row and writes nothing
R12 the capturing member is never recorded as the source of what someone else gave them: a source is a knocker's, never the pulling member's, and a capture a member fetched has none

tests: R20 sourceChangesSince answers each disclosure, consent and withdrawal of the source after `since` and at or before the read, in recorded order, each {at, act, entry} and nothing else; writes nothing and logs no read

R20 recorded order at one instant: a disclosure before a consent, each table in the order it was written
R20 asking R8 at each instant it names (and at `since`) finds a state that held only inside the interval: a consent withdrawn and given again
R20 refusals: NO_SUCH_SOURCE (C-121.1) as R8 answers it; a `since` that is not an ISO 8601 instant answers changes: null with since_invalid, never an empty list; it never throws
R20 N90's bound: at most `limit` changes (default 200, clamped 1…1000), with `truncated` and `next`, the cursor passed back as `after`
R20 is reached by no route and answered to no viewer: no op of this module calls it
R8 (T47) op=sourcepublishable evaluates at this module's own instant: a query `now` or `at` (or a body's) is ignored; the in-process publishableAt keeps its stated `at`
R6 linkClaim records a pseudonym_link disclosure with its evidence and merges nothing; a presented knocker secret of either source makes its basis same_secret; NO_SUCH_SOURCE for either side

R7 a consent covers one entry for one audience, stated as permanent; a withdrawal binds only later publications; CONSENT_NOT_STANDING for an entry not in the history or an audience lower than what already stands

R8 publishableAt answers each entry that may be shown to the audience, with its value and its basis (consent not withdrawn at `at`, or public_elsewhere: knownTo public with a citation, never a hostile one alone); every other entry is left out; it writes nothing and never throws

R21 sources declares sourcedisclose: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R21 sources declares sourcelink: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R21 sources declares sourceconsent: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R21 sources declares sourceconsentwithdraw: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R22 sources declares knockerconsent: no field is required, so no call names one, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused naming it
R22 sources: through the door a knockerconsent with its accepted fields records the consent, and each omitted field answers the one refusal, naming no field
R2 a disclosure is appended with its stamped by and instant, never edited; every kind, how and knownTo is admitted and a later entry supersedes an earlier one on read
R2 refusals in order, each with its row and a negative control: NO_SUCH_SOURCE, BAD_DISCLOSURE naming the field, NO_EVIDENCE; nothing is written

R1, R8 the sourceOfReads fixture: a capture with no source and a fetched capture answer NO_SUCH_SOURCE, a capture with a source answers its stated source and history, and publishableAt shows nothing unconsented
R13 every table here is exempt from purge: a whole-store and a one-bundle purge leave every row, and no other module may declare one
R13 a value is never written to a log, an error or a listener payload
R14 C-121.1–C-121.10 are held in this module's own table with their requirement's codes and translations (R16's four with them), and no place is named in its behaviour or outward text
R14 the ops: sourcedisclose, sourcelink, sourceconsent, sourceconsentwithdraw, knockerconsent and sourcekeyed reach their services with the control plane's stamps, never a body's
R19 every table is declared explicitly through record-core's declareTable with its classes, exempt from purge (R13); the disclosures, stored values, read log and keyed marks are never exported

R10 each registration goes through membership.listenerRefusal; each listener is called after every R2, R6, R7 (and R11) commit with {source, entry, rung_before, rung_after}; a listener's failure never undoes the act
